work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of the three DeepSeek V4.1 Flash lanes from a pinned sanitized proof package. All three frozen candidate outputs are evaluated by the same post-hoc eval_v3 suite. W1 preserves hard eval-v3 pass counts as the primary neutral metric and retains hidden-v2 passes, source score totals and elapsed sums only as auxiliary source telemetry.

source_known_dimensions: reasoning effort max in all three runners
same frozen 10 task set and agent-visible task/public-test inputs
same frozen candidate outputs evaluated under the same eval_v3 suite
candidate workspaces isolated from benchmark state
one stochastic candidate-generation run per lane
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact service-side DeepSeek V4.1 Flash checkpoint behind the published model slug
exact Hermes and DeepSeek Harness package/source revisions
runner-native control loops, tool surfaces and turn policies differ by study design
raw unsanitized traces remain local; public traces are sanitized exports with hash-linked redaction provenance
eval_v3 was authored after candidate generation and applied to frozen outputs rather than used to regenerate all candidates
trajectory variance beyond n=1 per lane

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admitted from the pinned sanitized proof package; sanitized trajectories are inspectable and hash-bound, while raw local traces remain explicitly unavailable

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The public repository implements same-model blind harness comparison and derived Elo computation, but real dataset inputs, deliverables and judge results are stored in gitignored local extras and/or MongoDB. No committed immutable result state was located in this pass.

The repository publishes a 40-task harness benchmark, deterministic checkers and strict matched-variable protocol, but W1 located no committed executed harness-comparison result artifact at the pinned revision.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: source lane ordering and claims about harness differences
non_admission_dispositions.reason: W1 preserves each lane's factual eval-v3 result and auxiliary telemetry without reproducing an ordering, winner label, or causal harness interpretation.
The source explicitly publishes sanitized trace copies only. Redaction manifests bind source and sanitized SHA-256 values without exposing redacted values.

commands_required: python scripts/admission_check.py <each of three pass-22 raw records>

results.scope: temporary write-enabled registry regeneration plus repository validation and three record-specific admission checks
